name: Lilith-Izm06 ~Digi Anime with Lily & Lilia Gaiden~
original_name: LILITH-IZM06 ～デジアニメwithリリー＆リリア外伝～
source:
This is the 6th volume of LILITH-IZM! The theme is "Digital anime with Lily and Lilia: another story"!! Popular scenes from "Annerose - the Witch of Iron" and "Kangoku Senkan (Inescapable Battleship) 2 - Brainwashing modification in the Fortified City" are made into beautiful anime! Furthermore! This volume includes 2 extra stories featuring Lily from "Tentacle and Witches" and Lilia from "Himekishi Lilia", both animated!

*Annerose - the Witch of Iron: the Anime / Kangoku Senkan (Inescapable Battleship) 2: the Anime*
Highly favored erotic scenes among users are made into digital animation! This or that scene from these two titles is now reproduced as amazing animation!

*Tentacle and Witches: Another Story*
After the incident of Faust, Ichirou ended the vacation in a tropical island. Since, he has been training his magical skills with a partner: Lily. Lily is in a bad temper since the incident in the island, and day by day the training becomes harder.
One day, Yoshiko leaves the key of the mansion with Ichiro.
He remembers that there are lots of books on magic and magical tools...

*Himekishi Lilia: Another Story*
Princess Lilia and her mother Queen Lyla are captured at Dilk's rebellion and subjected to sexually hardcore disciplines.
The untold story in the main game revives after 5 years! Don't miss this beautiful digital animation!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE074045.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是《LILITH-IZM》第6卷！主题是“数码动画with莉莉与莉莉娅：另一则故事”！！《安娜萝丝～钢铁魔女～》和《监狱战舰2～要塞都市的洗脑改造～》中受欢迎的场景被制作成精美动画！此外，本卷还收录两则额外故事，分别让《触手与魔女》的莉莉和《姬骑士莉莉娅》的莉莉娅登场，同样动画化！

*《安娜萝丝～钢铁魔女～动画版》／《监狱战舰2～要塞都市的洗脑改造～动画版》*
两部作品中最受用户欢迎的色情场景被制成数码动画！其中的场景如今以惊艳动画重现！

*《触手与魔女：另一则故事》*
浮士德事件后，壹郎在热带岛屿结束假期。此后，他与搭档莉莉一同训练魔法技能。莉莉因岛上事件心情恶劣，训练也一天天变得更加严苛。
一天，由子把宅邸钥匙交给壹郎。
他想起宅邸中有许多魔法书与魔法道具……

*《姬骑士莉莉娅：另一则故事》*
莉莉娅公主与母亲莱拉女王在迪尔克叛乱中被俘，遭受硬核性调教。
主游戏中未曾讲述的故事在五年后复活！不要错过这部精美数码动画！
